name: bthwani-suite
description: Bootstrap workspace shell for the bthwani-suite clean build line

scripts.phase:review: echo Review phase evidence under tools/registry/runs
scripts.guard:i18n-direction:mobile-control-pane: node tools/scripts/guard-central-i18n-direction.mjs app-client app-partner app-captain app-field control-panel webapp website
scripts.guard:test-coverage: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:test-coverage script is defined in this workspace.'"
scripts.guard:patch-review: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:patch-review script is defined; use the patch review workflow or governance review when explicitly requested.'"
scripts.guard:visual: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:visual script is defined; capture screenshots and visual notes instead.'"
scripts.guard:rtl-visual: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:rtl-visual script is defined; capture RTL screenshots and notes instead.'"
scripts.guard:runtime-smoke: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:runtime-smoke script is defined; run a project-specific smoke only on explicit request.'"
scripts.guard:tamagui-law: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: no dedicated guard:tamagui-law script is defined; use pnpm run guard:tamagui-import-boundary for the active Tamagui boundary check.'"
scripts.lint: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'NOT_RUN_REASON: workspace lint is opt-in only; use pnpm run lint:workspace on explicit PR or release request.'"
scripts.tamagui:check: pnpm run tamagui:version && pnpm run tamagui:build
scripts.guard:governance: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/guards/RUN_GOVERNANCE_GUARDS.ps1 -Mode Local -Profile Governance -Selection Auto
scripts.guard:governance:auto: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/guards/RUN_GOVERNANCE_GUARDS.ps1 -Mode Local -Profile Governance -Selection Auto
scripts.guard:governance:all: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/guards/RUN_GOVERNANCE_GUARDS.ps1 -Mode Local -Profile Governance -Selection All
